content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (P1) - cluster-us-west-2: ephemeral_storage_pressure -> eviction_count rising on node(s) gpu-node-17, gpu-node-19. Affected pods: modelcache-*, runtime-serve-*

pagerduty: Paging sara (oncall) - escalation policy: serving-runtime

sara: seeing the PD. joining. any customer-facing errors reported?

amos: console shows lots of OOMKilled container restarts on gpu-node-17, modelcache restarted 6x in last 4m.

lina: logs indicate modelcache is writing huge swap-like shadow files under /tmp/modelcache/kvdump. likely debug dump enabled accidentally. size growth ~200MB/s.

sara: can someone run `du -sh` on /var/lib/kubelet/pods/<pod>/volumes/* to see which volume is filling?

raj: running now. output:
```
/var/lib/kubelet/pods/abcdef0/volumes/kubernetes.io~empty-dir/modelcache: 72G
/var/lib/kubelet/pods/abcdef1/volumes/kubernetes.io~empty-dir/logs: 8G
/tmp/modelcache/kvdump: 68G
```

amos: confirmed. modelcache dump process writing to emptyDir/tmp on node local disk (not ephemeral SSD). eviction threshold hit -> kubelet evicting runtime pods.

sara: immediate mitigation: 1) disable modelcache dump, 2) rotate/delete older dumps to free space, 3) cordon gpu-node-17/19 to stop new pods, 4) scale down non-critical jobs. I'll take 1 and 3.

sara: @amos do you have the runbook link?

lina: runbook: https://internal/runbooks/ephemeral-disk-pressure. see section "modelcache large dump".

amos: disabling dump via config map patching now: `kubectl -n inference patch cm modelcache-config -p '{"data":{"dump_enabled":"false"}}'`

tom: applying patch returned success. pushing config to rolling daemonset.

lina: stopping dump process on node (ssh) and nuking in-progress files:
```
sudo pkill -f kvdump || true
sudo rm -rf /tmp/modelcache/kvdump/*
```

raj: freed ~66G on gpu-node-17. available disk now 80G.

sara: cordoning nodes to prevent churn: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 gpu-node-19`

amos: cordon successful. moving affected serving pods to other nodes by evicting gracefully (drain with --ignore-daemonsets).

lina: note: other nodes have less GPU headroom; routing policy fallback will reduce qps per replica to keep latency. putting system in degraded capacity.

pagerduty: Customer impact: initial telemetry shows 12% 5xx increase for hosted customers using large model endpoints in us-west-2 in last 6m. latency SLO violations up from 2% -> 14%.

sara: posting a short customer advisory to status page (preliminary) — marking region degraded.

raj: after cleanup, modelcache pods stable. runtime errors were mostly OOMKilled and some CUDA init failures due to abrupt restarts. GPU drivers looked fine on nodes.

tom: collecting dmesg + kubelet logs for postmortem:
```
[ 1234.567890] Killed process 12345 (modelcache) total-vm: 407000000kB, anon-rss: 400000000kB
May 15 12:18:02 gpu-node-17 kubelet[...]: eviction manager: attempting to reclaim ephemeral-storage
```

lina: also found a mis-set log level in modelcache (debug=true) introduced in 2025-04-10 deploy. that caused verbose dumps when certain cache-miss conditions triggered.

sara: who owns the modelcache deploy? @amos

amos: I do. rolling rollback to previous stable config (no debug dumps) in progress.

sara: handoff: I'm going to pager-rotation off in 30m. @amos you'll take post-incident owner and run the follow-up. I'll stay until region is stable.

amos: acknowledged — will own follow-up: check-in with infra to ensure eviction thresholds and kubelet evictionHard config align with SSD sizes. create task to add disk usage alarm earlier.

pagerduty: Update - Incident timeline created: 1995543210 (alert) -> mitigation (1995543360) -> recovery (1995543600).

lina: quick cluster health check: modelcache replicas healthy=12/12, runtime-serve healthy=24/24, no further evictions in last 10m.

sara: Customer impact summary for postmortem: approx 6 minutes of elevated errors, 12% increased 5xx for subset for ~10m window, degraded latency for 20% of requests in us-west-2. No data loss. Priority: high.

tom: added logs and artifacts to incident ticket INC-2025-3487. attaching `du` outputs, rm logs, dmesg snippet, kubelet eviction logs, and the config change diff.

amos: follow-ups I will own: 1) revert debug flag permanently and add pre-deploy checks (owner: amos), 2) add disk usage alert at 75% for emptyDir volumes (infra), 3) runbook update to include quick rm steps and cordon script (lina), 4) add unit to CI to prevent accidental dump_enabled=true in configs (engineering).

sara: thanks team. I'll update status page with resolution note in 10m and then close pager.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: region us-west-2 recovered. Severity P1 -> resolved. Postmortem required.

sara: closing thread but leaving follow-up tasks in INC-2025-3487. Good job. :thumbsup:
